title: Feature Flag Component Config
description: Declarative configuration for provisioning an individual feature flag within an OpenFeature compatible provider.

name.description: Optional component instance name (defaults to the manifest component name).

description.description: Human friendly description of the flag's purpose.

flagKey.description: Unique identifier for the feature flag. Used as the lookup key at runtime.

flagType.description: Data type of the flag value. Determines how variants and defaults are validated.

defaultValue.description: Default value returned when no targeting rule is matched or the provider is unavailable.

enabled.description: Whether the flag is enabled by default.

targetingRules.description: Progressive delivery configuration for percentage rollouts, contextual targeting, and multi-variant experiments.

percentage.description: Percentage of traffic that should receive the default variant (0-100).

conditions.description: Context based targeting rules evaluated by the provider.

attribute.description: Context attribute used for evaluation (e.g., userTier, region).

operator.description: Comparison operator supported by the provider.

variant.description: Optional variant name to serve when the condition matches.

variants.description: Named variants for multi-value flags (string/object). Each variant must define a weight.

value.description: Value served when this variant is selected.

weight.description: Relative percentage weight (0-100). All variants should total 100.

constraints.description: JSON schema fragment used to validate flag values at deployment time.

deploymentStrategyId.description: Custom deployment strategy identifier to use for feature rollout.

kmsKeyArn.description: KMS key ARN enforcing encryption for hosted configuration versions.

tags.description: LaunchDarkly tags attached to the flag.

temporary.description: Marks the flag as temporary to support cleanup workflows.

initialValue.description: Initial value when the flag is created.

monitoring.description: Monitoring and observability configuration for the flag workflow.

enabled.description: Enables monitoring integration for the flag.

detailedMetrics.description: Publishes extended CloudWatch metrics for evaluation latency and errors.

alarms.description: Flag specific alarm thresholds used by observability recipes.

evaluationLatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed evaluation latency before triggering an alarm.

errorRatePercent.description: Maximum allowed flag evaluation error rate percentage.

tags.description: Additional tags merged with the platform mandatory tag set. Custom values supplement the automatically applied keys `feature-flag-key`, `feature-flag-type`, and `openfeature-standard`.
